title: Welcome to {{assistantName}}
content:
# Hi, I'm {{assistantName}}

I'm your AI teammate. Tell me the outcome you need, and I bring the finished result back here.

## Here is what I can deliver

### Images

Campaign visuals, product illustrations, social graphics, ad creative.

![Campaign visual delivered by {{assistantName}}]({{imageUrl}})

`campaign-visual.jpg`

### Presentations

A rough brief becomes a designed deck that is ready to present.

[`sproutpop-launch-deck.html`]({{presentationUrl}}) · {{slideCount}} slides

### Websites

A launch page, a portfolio, a menu. Start from a built-in template and get a live page.

[`coastal-hotel-example.html`]({{websiteUrl}}) · built-in website template

### Research and data

Ask about the world outside your workspace and I go get it, with the sources kept. Nothing to set up, no API keys. Try one of these:

**[Social research]({{webServicesUrl}}/social-data)** — profiles, posts, comments, and video transcripts across six platforms

Try it: [“Find the creators talking about small-business bookkeeping on TikTok and YouTube this month. Give me audience size, what they cover, and links.”]({{origin}}/?prompt=Find%20the%20creators%20talking%20about%20small-business%20bookkeeping%20on%20TikTok%20and%20YouTube%20this%20month.%20Give%20me%20audience%20size%2C%20what%20they%20cover%2C%20and%20links.)

**[Find people and creators]({{webServicesUrl}}/people-search)** — people by role, employer, skill, or location, with sources

Try it: [“Find 20 heads of customer support at Series A to C SaaS companies in Europe, with a link to each profile.”]({{origin}}/?prompt=Find%2020%20heads%20of%20customer%20support%20at%20Series%20A%20to%20C%20SaaS%20companies%20in%20Europe%2C%20with%20a%20link%20to%20each%20profile.)

**[News and web search]({{webServicesUrl}}/web-search)** — ranked public-web results, filtered by recency and domain

Try it: [“What was announced about AI agents in the last 7 days? Group it by company and keep the sources.”]({{origin}}/?prompt=What%20was%20announced%20about%20AI%20agents%20in%20the%20last%207%20days%3F%20Group%20it%20by%20company%20and%20keep%20the%20sources.)

**[SEO and keywords]({{webServicesUrl}}/seo-data)** — live search results, ranking keywords, backlink totals

Try it: [“Which keywords does our top competitor rank for that we do not, and which ones are worth writing about?”]({{origin}}/?prompt=Which%20keywords%20does%20our%20top%20competitor%20rank%20for%20that%20we%20do%20not%2C%20and%20which%20ones%20are%20worth%20writing%20about%3F)

**[Market data]({{webServicesUrl}}/market-data)** — company profiles, latest quotes, price history

Try it: [“Compare the last 12 months of NVDA and AMD and tell me what moved each one.”]({{origin}}/?prompt=Compare%20the%20last%2012%20months%20of%20NVDA%20and%20AMD%20and%20tell%20me%20what%20moved%20each%20one.)

**[Read any page]({{webServicesUrl}}/web-scraping)** — a public page turned into clean text or a list of links

Try it: [“Read this pricing page and turn it into a table I can compare with ours: [paste the URL]”]({{origin}}/?prompt=Read%20this%20pricing%20page%20and%20turn%20it%20into%20a%20table%20I%20can%20compare%20with%20ours%3A%20%5Bpaste%20the%20URL%5D)

### Workflow examples

More involved jobs other teams already run. Open one to read the finished result, or run it here and I will set it up with you.

**[Weekly growth report]({{workflowExamplesUrl}}/website-analytics-to-weekly-growth-report)** — traffic and product behavior reconciled into one weekly read

Run it: [“Build me a weekly website growth report from our analytics: traffic, conversion changes, and what to fix first.”]({{origin}}/?prompt=Build%20me%20a%20weekly%20website%20growth%20report%20from%20our%20analytics%3A%20traffic%2C%20conversion%20changes%2C%20and%20what%20to%20fix%20first.)

**[Inbox morning brief]({{workflowExamplesUrl}}/daily-inbox-triage)** — a day of email sorted into answer, waiting, and noise

Run it: [“Every weekday morning, turn my last 24 hours of email into a brief: what needs an answer, what is waiting on someone else, and what is noise.”]({{origin}}/?prompt=Every%20weekday%20morning%2C%20turn%20my%20last%2024%20hours%20of%20email%20into%20a%20brief%3A%20what%20needs%20an%20answer%2C%20what%20is%20waiting%20on%20someone%20else%2C%20and%20what%20is%20noise.)

**[Sales meeting follow-up]({{workflowExamplesUrl}}/sales-call-to-follow-up-draft)** — a deal brief, CRM notes, and the follow-up email as a draft

Run it: [“After each sales call, turn the transcript into a deal brief, write the notes to our CRM, and leave me a follow-up email as a draft.”]({{origin}}/?prompt=After%20each%20sales%20call%2C%20turn%20the%20transcript%20into%20a%20deal%20brief%2C%20write%20the%20notes%20to%20our%20CRM%2C%20and%20leave%20me%20a%20follow-up%20email%20as%20a%20draft.)

**[Weekly paid ads review]({{workflowExamplesUrl}}/weekly-paid-ads-optimization)** — where the budget went and what to change next week

Run it: [“Every Monday, review last week's Google Ads spend and tell me what to change. Do not apply anything without my approval.”]({{origin}}/?prompt=Every%20Monday%2C%20review%20last%20week%27s%20Google%20Ads%20spend%20and%20tell%20me%20what%20to%20change.%20Do%20not%20apply%20anything%20without%20my%20approval.)

**[Brief to landing page]({{workflowExamplesUrl}}/brand-brief-to-landing-page)** — a brief becomes a live page, deployed and shareable

Run it: [“Turn this brief into a responsive landing page and put it online: [paste the brief]”]({{origin}}/?prompt=Turn%20this%20brief%20into%20a%20responsive%20landing%20page%20and%20put%20it%20online%3A%20%5Bpaste%20the%20brief%5D)

**[Recording to explainer video]({{workflowExamplesUrl}}/screen-recording-to-explainer-video)** — a screen recording becomes a narrated explainer

Run it: [“Turn this screen recording into a narrated explainer video: [attach the recording]”]({{origin}}/?prompt=Turn%20this%20screen%20recording%20into%20a%20narrated%20explainer%20video%3A%20%5Battach%20the%20recording%5D)

[See all workflow examples]({{workflowExamplesUrl}})

## Start from a workflow template

Pick a template instead of a blank page. Run it once, save what worked as your own workflow, then give it a schedule so it runs without anyone asking.

![The workflow template picker, filtered by role]({{workflowTemplatePickerUrl}})

Open **Template** in the chat composer, choose **Workflow**, and filter by the work you do.

[Browse the templates]({{origin}}/) · [See what they produce]({{workflowExamplesUrl}})

## Then give the job its own agent

You start with the agent this workspace comes with. When a job has its own rules, give it an agent of its own: its own instructions, its own access, its own workflows.

![Creating a new agent, with visibility set to private]({{newAgentDialogUrl}})

**Share it with the team.** Set **Visibility** to **Public** and everyone in the workspace can use it. They get the instructions you wrote and the workflows you saved; each person connects their own accounts.

[Open Agents]({{agentsUrl}}) · [“Create an agent for customer support and keep it private for now.”]({{origin}}/?prompt=Create%20an%20agent%20for%20customer%20support%20and%20keep%20it%20private%20for%20now.)

## Talk to me in Slack and Telegram

Once I am installed, the answer arrives in the conversation instead of in another tab. Mention me in a channel or group, or send a direct message.

![In a channel: You mention {{assistantName}}; {{assistantName}} replies in the thread. In a direct message: one private conversation that keeps its context.]({{slackConversationsDiagramUrl}})

## The steps, in one deck

Six steps with real product screenshots: first prompts, a workflow template, connectors, saving your own workflow, a schedule, your own agent, and inviting the team.

[![Open the quick start]({{quickStartCoverUrl}})]({{quickStartUrl}})

[Open the quick start]({{quickStartUrl}}) · [`okou-quick-start.pptx`]({{quickStartDownloadUrl}}) · {{quickStartSlideCount}} slides

[Set up Slack and Telegram]({{worksUrl}}) so workflows start where you talk.

[Invite your teammates]({{inviteUrl}}) so what you build is reusable on day one.

[Read the docs]({{docsUrl}}) for how shared agents and workflows work.
